name: scenario_AccessPoint_first_setup_from_its_own_network
description: First setup the way a user does it, with this computer as the phone. The device forgets the network, restarts and opens its access point; the computer joins it and finds the sign-in redirect; the network is picked from the scan, the password typed and Connect pressed; the computer follows to the device on the network. It takes the computer off its network for a few minutes, so it runs only when named, with --network naming a moondeck.json network that the device reaches on 2.4 GHz and that it knows no other network beside.

steps.name: opens-on-failure
steps.description: The default, so the access point opens when nothing joins.

steps.name: forget-the-network
steps.description: A device that never knew it, as on first setup.

steps.name: restart-with-nothing-to-join
steps.description: Nothing it knows is in range, so it opens its access point.

steps.name: join-its-access-point
steps.description: The computer joins the network named after the device.

steps.name: a-phone-sees-the-sign-in-screen
steps.description: The check every phone makes on joining resolves to the access point and is sent to the UI, which is what shows it the sign-in screen. Resolved at the access point as a phone does, since macOS holds a captive network's answers back from other apps.

steps.name: type-the-password
steps.description: The access point scanned on opening, so the network is listed; its password goes into its row.

steps.name: back-on-the-access-point
steps.description: The join moves the radio to the router's channel, which knocks the computer off; the access point holds for two minutes, so it rejoins.

steps.name: the-card-links-to-the-device
steps.description: Joined: the card shows the address to follow.

steps.name: follow-it-home
steps.description: The computer goes back to its network, where the device now is.

steps.name: found-by-its-name
steps.description: Its .local name reaches it too, which is the link a phone that left the access point follows.

steps.name: remembered
steps.description: Joined, so the network is known now, and the next restart joins it.
